title: Suno Field Guide
reported_observation: Public guide covers model selection, prompt engineering, song structure and metatags, style-field tag strategies, lyrics, realism, production, advanced parameters and lyric-level control. It uses a 'probabilistic style-mesh' and pop gravity-well narrative.
creator_interpretation: Useful as a vocabulary bank and hypothesis collection. Its claims about co-occurrence, pop defaults and hidden behavior require checking against the underlying data and independent experiments.
our_hypothesis: Extract claims into a claim ledger, compare them to the raw co-occurrence data and test whether their effects persist across v6 variants.
limitations: Metadata and excerpt summary from publicly accessible web results; inspect full source before promotion.
Community claims do not reveal proprietary Suno internals.
